set.title: Set
set.description: Add a key/value pair. If key exists, it will be overwritten. Format: KEY VALUE

add.title: Add
add.description: Add a key/value pair only if key doesn't exist. Format: KEY VALUE

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Remove a key/value pair if it exists. Format: KEY

remove_wildcard.title: Remove Wildcard
remove_wildcard.description: Remove all key/value pairs with key matching wildcard pattern. Format: WILDCARD

remove_regex.title: Remove Regex
remove_regex.description: Remove all key/value pairs with key matching regular expression. Format: REGEXP

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename a key if it exists and new name doesn't exist. Format: KEY RENAMED_KEY

hard_rename.title: Hard Rename
hard_rename.description: Rename a key if it exists. Overwrites if new name already exists. Format: KEY RENAMED_KEY

copy.title: Copy
copy.description: Copy a key if it exists and copy name doesn't exist. Format: KEY COPIED_KEY

hard_copy.title: Hard Copy
hard_copy.description: Copy a key if it exists. Overwrites if copy name already exists. Format: KEY COPIED_KEY

move_to_start.title: Move to Start
move_to_start.description: Move key/value pairs matching wildcard to the start of the message. Format: WILDCARD

move_to_end.title: Move to End
move_to_end.description: Move key/value pairs matching wildcard to the end of the message. Format: WILDCARD

condition.title: Conditions
condition.description: Conditions that must all be true for rules to apply. Format: CONDITION_TYPE [KEY] [VALUE]
